title: Kto je tá nová?
topic: Martin looks for the new colleague Eva described, greets the wrong woman, and finds out who the new girl's parents are

sentences.sk: V pondelok prišla do kancelárie nová kolegyňa.
sentences.en: On Monday a new colleague started at the office.

sentences.sk: Martin ju ešte nevidel, ale Eva mu o nej veľa rozprávala.
sentences.en: Martin hasn't seen her yet, but Eva has told him a lot about her.

sentences.sk: Eva, povedz mi niečo o novej kolegyni. Aká je?
sentences.en: Eva, tell me something about the new colleague. What's she like?

sentences.sk: Je vysoká, má dlhé tmavé vlasy a nosí okuliare.
sentences.en: She's tall, she has long dark hair, and she wears glasses.

sentences.sk: Je veľmi milá a vždy veselá. Páči sa mi.
sentences.en: She's very nice and always cheerful. I like her.

sentences.sk: A ako sa volá?
sentences.en: And what's her name?

sentences.sk: Simona. Sedí pri okne vedľa šéfa.
sentences.en: Simona. She sits by the window, next to the boss.

sentences.sk: V utorok ráno vidí Martin pri okne vysokú ženu s dlhými tmavými vlasmi.
sentences.en: On Tuesday morning Martin sees a tall woman with long dark hair by the window.

sentences.sk: Rozpráva sa so šéfom a smeje sa.
sentences.en: She is talking with the boss and laughing.

sentences.sk: Dobrý deň! Vy ste určite Simona, naša nová kolegyňa.
sentences.en: Hello! You must be Simona, our new colleague.

sentences.sk: Nie, ja som Hana, manželka vášho šéfa.
sentences.en: No, I'm Hana, your boss's wife.

sentences.sk: Martinovi je hanba a je červený ako paradajka.
sentences.en: Martin is embarrassed and turns as red as a tomato.

sentences.sk: Prepáčte, nechcel som vás vyrušiť.
sentences.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to disturb you.

sentences.sk: Nevadí. Simonu nájdete v kuchynke, práve si robí kávu.
sentences.en: Never mind. You'll find Simona in the kitchen; she's making herself coffee.

sentences.sk: V kuchynke stojí vysoké dievča v okuliaroch s veľkou šálkou kávy.
sentences.en: A tall girl in glasses is standing in the kitchen with a big cup of coffee.

sentences.sk: Ahoj, ty budeš Martin? Eva mi o tebe hovorila.
sentences.en: Hi, you must be Martin? Eva told me about you.

sentences.sk: Áno. A ja som práve hovoril s manželkou nášho šéfa.
sentences.en: Yes. And I was just talking to our boss's wife.

sentences.sk: Myslel som, že ona je tá nová.
sentences.en: I thought she was the new girl.

sentences.sk: Tá vysoká pani pri okne? To je moja mama!
sentences.en: That tall lady by the window? That's my mom!

sentences.sk: Tvoja mama? Takže náš šéf je tvoj otec?
sentences.en: Your mom? So our boss is your dad?

sentences.sk: Áno, ale nikomu to nehovor, prosím.
sentences.en: Yes, but please don't tell anyone.

sentences.sk: Martin sa smeje a Simona s ním.
sentences.en: Martin laughs, and Simona laughs with him.

sentences.sk: Večer Martin volá Eve.
sentences.en: In the evening Martin calls Eva.

sentences.sk: Máš pravdu, Simona je milá. Myslím, že ju mám rád.
sentences.en: You're right, Simona is nice. I think I like her.

sentences.sk: Ja viem. A viem aj to, kto je jej otec.
sentences.en: I know. And I also know who her father is.

options: Je malá a má krátke vlasy.
Je stará a má biele vlasy.

recap: Eva describes the new colleague Simona to Martin. He greets a tall woman by the window, but she is the boss's wife, and in the kitchen Simona tells him that woman is her mom, so the boss is her dad.

budeš.gloss: you will be (ty budeš Martin: you must be Martin)
